question: Should OpenClaw accept longest-prefix reload-rule matching plus `browser.profiles.*` hot reload as the new compatibility contract for overlapping config reload prefixes?
rationale: The code change is a good bug fix, but it intentionally changes reload precedence and user-visible restart behavior for a shipped config area, so maintainers should explicitly own that contract before merge.

options.title: Accept With Docs Update
options.body: Update the browser docs, keep service-level browser settings restart-scoped, and land this PR after current-head checks pass.

options.title: Keep First-Match Semantics
options.body: Ask for a narrower fix that avoids changing generic reload-rule precedence, such as a dedicated rule ordering shape approved by gateway owners.

options.title: Pause For Reload Policy Review
options.body: Hold the PR until gateway owners decide a broader reload precedence policy for plugin and channel overlaps.

recommendation.title: Accept With Docs Update
recommendation.body: Update the browser docs, keep service-level browser settings restart-scoped, and land this PR after current-head checks pass.

likelyOwner.reason: Most affected browser/plugin and gateway reload history in this checkout points to steipete, making him the best available owner for the reload-contract choice.
